questions.prompt: What is the main job of a trading plan?

options.text: To make decisions in advance, so your trading is consistent and reviewable
options.explanation: Right: rules made while calm, then followed and checked.

options.text: To list every market situation you might meet, and exactly what to do in each
options.explanation: No: no plan can list everything. A plan should be short enough to follow.

questions.prompt: A demo balance is 8,000 USD. The example daily loss limit is 2%. Risk per trade is 80 USD. After how many full losses do you stop?

options.explanation: No: one loss is 80 USD, and the limit is 160 USD.
No: 4 losses would be 320 USD, double the limit.

questions.prompt: Which rule is clear enough to test?

options.explanation: No: this cannot be checked on a chart.

options.text: "Sell when a 1-hour candle closes below the last swing low"
options.explanation: Right: anyone can check this at the time.

questions.prompt: Stop distance 25 pips, pip value 2 USD, risk limit 40 USD. Does the trade fit?

options.text: Yes: the stop is only 25 pips, which is well inside a 40-pip limit
options.explanation: No: the limit is 40 USD of risk, not 40 pips. 25 × 2 = 50 USD, which is over the limit.

options.text: No: 25 × 2 = 50 USD is over the 40 USD limit, so reduce size or skip
options.explanation: Right: the money at risk breaks the limit.

questions.prompt: You are angry after a loss. Your checklist asks "Am I calm?" What do you do?

options.text: Answer yes, since the setup matches your plan anyway
options.explanation: No: the checklist only works if you answer honestly, even when the setup looks good.

options.text: Answer no, and wait or skip for now
options.explanation: Right: not being calm raises a caution, so you wait or skip that trade.

options.text: So you can go back to an older version whenever a new one has a losing week or two
options.explanation: No: judging a version by a week or two of results is chasing outcomes. Changes belong between sessions, recorded so you can compare how each version was followed.

options.text: So each change is recorded and you can compare how each version was followed
options.explanation: Right: versions let you learn from changes instead of drifting.
